newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Friday June 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Friday June 27.

text.p: Following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.

* Centre-left government said it would review the question of tax evasion and employment in forthcoming welfare talks which will include a 1995 reform of the state pensions system . Prime minister Romano Prodi said various working parties, to be made up of union, business and government representatives, will meet in the first half of July (all).

* The upper house of parliament (Senate) approved a decree that will open the way for a tender for Italy's third mobile licence. The tender will be opened in mid-July and licence will be awarded between end of November and middle of December (all).
* A study published by employers' federation Confindustria (CSC) said Italian industrial production fell by 0.3 percent in June, but sales and orders rose strongly (Il Sole 24 Ore).

* Carmelo Caruso, chairman of insurance group SAI, said the group saw a 7.6 percent rise in premium income to 1.504 trillion lire in the first five months of 1997. The group nominated a new board that failed to elect the new chairman (all).

* EU Commission set to allow 2.75 trillion lire recapitalisation of state airline Alitalia, rather than three trillion requested. Commission expected to give its judgement on next few weeks (Corriere).
Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
